codeReview.summary: Solid implementation of buildPlanContext() that generates a compact plan representation with milestone statuses, current milestone features, and current feature details. The function is clean, well-guarded for edge cases (no plan, no current milestone, no current feature), and integrates naturally into executingProtocol(). The progressSummary() fix to prefer the current milestone's next pending feature is a sensible improvement. All 9 new tests pass and cover the validation assertions comprehensively. The 30-line constraint is met for a 10-feature plan (actual: ~13 non-empty lines).

issues.description: extractPlanContextLines() breaks at the first '## ' line after '## MILESTONES', so it only captures the MILESTONES section — not the FEATURES or CURRENT FEATURE sections. The 30-line constraint test (VAL-PLANCTX-004) therefore only validates ~3 lines instead of the full plan context (~13 lines). The constraint is still met in practice, but the test helper doesn't fully validate what the test name claims.

Token budget test threshold was raised from 3000 to 4000 chars to accommodate plan context. This is a reasonable adjustment but worth noting — the executing protocol grew by ~30% in character length. Future additions may need further threshold increases.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The plan context uses '## MILESTONES', '## {name} FEATURES', and '## CURRENT FEATURE' as markdown headers within the protocol output. This is a convention for the dynamic section format that isn't documented in AGENTS.md. Future features modifying the dynamic section should know about these section headers to avoid conflicts.

summary: Feature passes review. The buildPlanContext() implementation is clean, well-structured, and meets all validation assertions (VAL-PLANCTX-001 through VAL-PLANCTX-004 and VAL-CROSS-005). The function correctly renders milestone statuses, current milestone features, and current feature details in a compact format. Non-current milestones are summarized by feature count only. The 30-line constraint is comfortably met (~13 lines for 10 features). One non-blocking test quality issue: the extractPlanContextLines helper in the line-count test only captures the MILESTONES section due to its break condition, though the constraint is still satisfied. The progressSummary() change to prefer the current milestone's next pending feature is a sensible improvement with proper fallback.
